name: a serif headline sits above a building inbox list
looks: On a near-black field with thin corner brackets, a serif headline fades up with its last word in italic, an email address types in above a short list that fills in one row at a time beneath it, with a QR-style noise square resolving in the corner.
build: hud-frame's corner brackets persist over the shot; the address and list rows reveal with kit.typeOn and a staggered fade; the corner square is a noise-dissolve-logomark-style seeded-point resolve into a small textured mark.
sound: A soft typing tick, a quiet chime per list row.
prompt: On a near-black field with thin corner frame marks, fade up a serif headline with its final word in italic, then type in an address above a short list that fills in one row at a time. Resolve a small textured mark in the corner from noise into a crisp icon as the beat settles.
